purpose: Test the repeated external-review condition: reference-free, quality-controlled terminal root-level model-selection harm on at least two unseen task blocks.

review_trigger.recurring_concern: The strongest terminal effect uses public-reference T2; existing T1 transfers cumulative but not substantial terminal harm.
review_trigger.disclosure: This is a prospective follow-up designed after reading those reviews. It is not represented as part of the earlier Step 56 preregistration.

prior_inspection_disclosure.project_search: Before this lock, exact subject-name search returned zero project files for all 18 frozen subjects.
prior_inspection_disclosure.forbidden_replacement: No domain block or subject may be replaced after this lock, including after a structural failure or unfavorable result.

public_source.response_canonicalization: Use stripped HELM mapped_output when present; otherwise prefix stripped predicted_text with INVALID:. Score by exact equality to the unique reference tagged correct.

split.rule: Within each domain block, concatenate subjects in the listed order, then sort examples by SHA-256 of [manifest_id, split, block, public ID]. The first floor(N/2) are calibration and the remainder are sealed holdout.

stage_separation.calibration: May contain all candidate responses and references.
stage_separation.blind_parent_input: One file per candidate and block containing only IDs, prompts, public options, and that candidate's outputs.
stage_separation.attack_builder: Selects a parent from calibration, then opens only that parent's blind file. It may not read the sealed holdout outcomes, peer holdout outputs, pools, or selector state.
stage_separation.holdout_outcomes: Remain sealed until the attack rows and Stage-B execution lock are hashed.

evaluation_protocol.selector: equation-faithful Select-LLM V2 backend used by the manuscript
evaluation_protocol.temperature_selection: Choose the temperature with minimum clean calibration cumulative root regret over 200 pools; ties choose the smaller value. No attacked outcome enters this choice.

attack.distance: Each alias changes max(1, floor(0.01*N)) coordinates, so holdout oracle disagreement and absolute accuracy shift are deterministically at most one percentage point.
attack.error_learner: Five-fold OOF TF-IDF logistic regression on calibration prompt, public options, and parent output; refit on all calibration data for holdout scoring.
attack.replacement: Deterministic SHA-256-ranked public non-parent option; never use the reference when choosing an output.
attack.parent_and_policy_selection: Among all parents and the fixed policy grid, maximize calibration mean adaptive-minus-fixed terminal root-regret effect; tie-break by active terminal root regret, then adaptive-minus-fixed cumulative root regret, then smaller parent index and policy name.

statistics_and_controls.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across the six frozen blocks, separately for active terminal root harm and adaptive-minus-fixed terminal root harm.
statistics_and_controls.fixed_query_control: Clean and refined scenarios receive the same registry-independent random query matrix for each pool.

task_gate.quality: All aliases have absolute holdout accuracy gap <= 0.01 and oracle-vector disagreement <= 0.01.
task_gate.integrity: Four distinct non-parent response hashes, exact declared distance, no forbidden holdout input, and byte-identical fixed-query matrices.
task_gate.active_terminal_root_harm: Paired 95% lower bound > 0 and BH q < 0.05.
task_gate.adaptive_terminal_excess: For each pool, subtract the fixed-query terminal root-regret delta from the active delta; paired 95% lower bound > 0 and BH q < 0.05.
task_gate.fixed_query_boundary: The fixed-query terminal root effect is reported and cannot be omitted; a positive fixed effect does not invalidate the task if adaptive excess passes, but forbids an exact-zero mediation claim.

overall_decision.PROMOTE_REFERENCE_FREE_TERMINAL_BRIDGE: At least two of six frozen blocks pass every task gate.
overall_decision.NARROW_TERMINAL_BRIDGE: Exactly one block passes every task gate.
overall_decision.NO_TERMINAL_PROMOTION: No block passes or any global separation/integrity gate fails.

forbidden_rescues: No task, subject, model, policy, budget, temperature grid, seed, metric, or gate may change after this lock.
No holdout-better parent or policy may replace the calibration-selected one.
No failed endpoint or malformed scenario may be replaced.
Cumulative harm alone cannot satisfy the terminal bridge.
An unfavorable result remains in the paper record if Step 87 is discussed.
